result.title: Closing Remarks
result.description: Join us for a summary of the key insights, conclusions and next steps from the Annual Meeting of the New Champions 2026.

result.title: Innovating at Scale
result.description:
The cost of deploying next-generation technologies is falling faster than most organizations can absorb. Economies are racing to keep pace – not only through invention but through adoption and organizational change. 

As the barriers to innovation drop, what does it mean for large-scale industry and economic transformation?

result.title: Poetic Skylines
result.description:
Amid the rise of urbanization and the complex intertwined challenges that have emerged from infrastructure to health, architecture is having a moment.  

Join award-winning architect Ma Yansong on an exploration of how human imagination is being blended with emerging technologies to fuel designs that bring wonder, provoke thought and connect people to their surroundings.

result.title: 15th Five-Year Plan, Unpacked
result.description:
As China enters its 15th Five-Year Plan period, policy priorities are focused on boosting domestic demand, upgrading industry through innovation and accelerating the green transition across sectors from advanced manufacturing to new energy.

Are the conditions right for China to transition to an innovation and consumption-led economy?

result.title: Ideas on the Move: Lady Marieme Jamme
result.description:
What does gender equality look like in the age of AI?

For Lady Marieme Jamme, founder of I am the CODE, it means girls from refugee camps and slums building their own AI bots.

Episode 3 of Ideas on the Move, live from Dalian. 🎬 #IdeasOnTheMove #AMNC26 #AI
